thesis: The evening-routine source combines personal preparation practices with explicit departures from optimization rules.
summary: Reviewed passages link evening preparation to the next day and describe the creator's personal food, heat, and sleep-related practices. He explicitly departs from some common optimization rules and says a device did not produce a benefit in his own sleep data. The routine includes commercial products and health claims. Those claims and the title's scientific framing are not independently validated by this note.
